note: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's published text, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each cites its sources. Hidden flags (28 hidden, 27 visible) and counts follow the Exophase / PSNProfiles list as reported by EGamers.io on 18 November 2026. Where no source confirms a method, the guide says so and sticks to what the official description supports.
sources: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (names, descriptions, grades, hidden flags)
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies And Achievements (18 Nov 2026)
Press-Start — Here's The Full Trophy/Achievement List For Grand Theft Auto 6 (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task here. Work through the roadmap stages in order and this one closes the list for you.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission of the story and cannot be missed; the trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies pop as the story advances, so keep playing the main missions and this one arrives on its own.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Both protagonists become playable around this point, which opens up most of the side content, so it is a good moment to start the stranger mission chains too.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Story trophies are unmissable: as long as you keep playing the main missions, the chapter trophy follows.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The optional bank-vault mission chain that feeds the Maximum Withdrawal trophy also opens in this chapter, so look for it before the story moves on.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Keep a manual save from just before it: several guides recommend one in case a late choice or a missed side task needs a second look, and there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play the mission Breakfast Run through to its end. Named-mission trophies like this one pop when the mission completes and cannot be missed by playing the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist through to its end. It is a story heist mission, so it arrives in the natural course of the campaign.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play the mission Child's Play through to its end. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is unmissable if you finish the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Play the mission Headliners through to its end. The trophy pops on mission completion.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Play the mission VCIA Takedown through to its end. It takes place at the airport, which is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy is earned, so the two pair naturally.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory through to its end. The trophy pops on mission completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. PowerPyx puts the checklist at roughly 60% of true completion and says most of it comes from the other trophies, so finish the story, the activities and the collectibles first and use the checklist to mop up what is left. Both GTABase and PowerPyx rank this the hardest trophy in the set.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida. EGamers.io reports 397 stunts exist in total and that flying under bridges is the quickest kind, so use a plane or helicopter and chain bridge passes. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so the trophy pops before that target is done.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game once. The starter list counts 9 types; work through the in-game activities menu — fishing, races, shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races, stunts and the rest — and tick each one off as you sample it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. EGamers.io confirms the count of 42; work through the range's challenge list one at a time and repeat any challenge until the gold medal lands.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. PowerPyx counts 42 races across those 14 spots, so expect several races per location and keep going until every location shows a win.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — each race only counts once, so vary the events instead of repeating one you like. The 100% checklist asks for 30 wins, so this trophy pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing is one of the activities, so learn the casting and reeling rhythm in a casual session first, then challenge Cal.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine and finish one of its games from start to end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you can clear reliably.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Side-character strands unlock as the story advances; one guide warns their windows may be tied to story progress, so start Andy's strand as soon as it appears rather than leaving it to the end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Start the strand when it unlocks and keep it moving alongside the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Start the strand when it unlocks and keep it moving alongside the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore; there are more than 8 strands in the game, so pick the ones nearest your route and finish each strand to its end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Start the strand when it unlocks and keep it moving alongside the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Start the strand when it unlocks and keep it moving alongside the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. GTABase counts 18 spots; the 100% checklist counts 15, and the two sources disagree, so visit every spot you can find and do not stop at 15. This is the one trophy GTABase and PowerPyx both flag as possibly missable: the first meditation, Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is reported to disappear once that chapter ends, and there is no mission replay — do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Which animal it is has not been confirmed by any source yet, so follow Bret's strand when it appears and take the hunt it gives you; the guide will be updated once a source confirms the target.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; EGamers.io notes 15 sets exist in total against a 100% checklist that asks for all 15, so 3 sets is an early milestone on the way to a full collection. Pick up cards whenever you pass them rather than hunting them all at once.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations across Leonida. WAiNK is the in-game phone feature for scanning and tagging places, so open it at landmarks, businesses and viewpoints as you travel; the same habit also feeds the vehicle-discovery trophy.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small tasks the game tracks across activities, driving, combat and exploration; they accumulate naturally while you play, and the 100% checklist asks for 70, so this trophy pops on the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape the heat zone. Both guides point to a train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a good escape route, and bank vault robberies are a reliable way to build the wanted level in the first place.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. GTABase notes the jewelry stores in North Vice City sit close together, which keeps the run short, and says to rob a fourth shop if the trophy does not pop after the third.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. GTABase reports you scan them with WAiNK, with no need to drive them, so scan traffic near busy roads as you travel. Pair this with the WAiNK locations trophy and the vehicle count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter before you start, then trigger it in a busy fight; the guides suggest gang members with an assault rifle, and note that cops, soldiers and civilians do not appear to count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way. GTABase reports the method is to steal a docked passenger jet and fly about a kilometre away from the airport — take the jet, get airborne and keep flying until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get inside a Rhino tank and use it. GTABase reports the method is to steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it, so head there, grab a Rhino and start engaging targets.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without anyone spotting you. EGamers.io reports the method: open the store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, clear out the safe and leave unseen. Plan the route before you go in and move quietly.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. EGamers.io reports the chain needs the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars on the escape and keep a fast bike ready.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape afterwards. Armored trucks run routes around the state; hit one, take the cash and break line of sight before the wanted level climbs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. EGamers.io reports this means clearing the fog across the whole map, and that flying over the dark patches is the quickest method — take a plane or helicopter and sweep the uncovered regions until the map is clear.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. GTABase counts 9 gangs; work through the gang operations map marker by marker until every gang has been hit once.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact steps are not yet confirmed by any source — PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known — so the official description is the only guide for now: find a bar or vendor on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom. GTABase thinks this involves crashing a car out through a showroom window, though that is unconfirmed, and PowerPyx marks the trophy as not yet known — so take a car into a showroom and drive it out through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. EGamers.io lists the trophy as confirmed but notes the wording is unclear, and Output Lag reports the alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2 — go bowling there and follow through on the lane.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build the partnership's mass appeal. GTABase reports this means maxing out the Strength attribute for both Jason and Lucia, so train both characters' Strength to maximum.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices that change your Criminal Profile. GTABase reports the count is 500 actions that affect the profile — a single source, so treat the number as reported rather than confirmed. Play the way the game asks: pick sides, take jobs and make calls, and the count climbs as you go. EGamers.io notes the Criminal Profile is permanent, so check its guide before going on a rampage.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. No source has confirmed the exact trigger yet — PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known — so the official description is the only guide for now: it most likely pops when something you failed the first time succeeds on the retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. No source has confirmed the exact trigger yet — PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known, and GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida. Keep an eye out for odd encounters while exploring; the trophy pops when you find one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock targets down with a melee drive-by. The exact steps are not yet confirmed by any source — PowerPyx marks this trophy as not yet known — so the official description is the guide: use a melee weapon from a moving vehicle to bowl targets over.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. GTABase reports the bills are laundered through fences, one of which pays the most, and that the total grows during the 100% robberies — keep laundering after every robbery and the total climbs.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Any purchase counts, so buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and supplies as you play; the total is cumulative and the trophy pops once your spending crosses the line.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. EGamers.io reports they are sold through the Vice City Real Estate app for around $160,000 in total, and that the 4 story garages do not count — buy the 8 purchasable ones through the app.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one until the count reaches 10.
trophies.name: On the Spot
